title: Rheumatoid Arthritis Through Education and US Study (RAEUS)
brief_summary: Patients can potentially monitor disease activity of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) through self-assessed swollen joints (clinical synovitis)joint counts but reliability of joint swelling is poor. The objective is to evaluate the use of education by ultrasound feedback on the ability of patients to assess for clinical synovitis swollen joints in RA.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* RA patients fulfilling ACR1987 criteria
* adults between age 21 and 80 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnant
* no mental health illness
* fit to perform informed consent
